// PARTE 4: INTERFACE DE CHAT E INTERAÇÃO
// ============================================

let chatAtualId = null;
let conversaAtual = [];
let reconhecimentoVozAtivo = false;
let ttsAtivo = false;

// Inicializar reconhecimento de voz
const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
const reconhecimento = SpeechRecognition ? new SpeechRecognition() : null;

if (reconhecimento) {
    reconhecimento.lang = 'pt-BR';
    reconhecimento.continuous = false;
    reconhecimento.interimResults = false;

    reconhecimento.onstart = () => {
        document.getElementById('btnVoz').classList.add('ativo');
        reconhecimentoVozAtivo = true;
    };

    reconhecimento.onend = () => {
        document.getElementById('btnVoz').classList.remove('ativo');
        reconhecimentoVozAtivo = false;
    };

    reconhecimento.onresult = (event) => {
        let transcript = '';
        for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
            transcript += event.results[i][0].transcript;
        }
        document.getElementById('inputChat').value = transcript;
    };

    reconhecimento.onerror = (event) => {
        console.error('Erro no reconhecimento:', event.error);
        mostrarNotificacao('Erro no reconhecimento de voz', 'erro');
    };
}

function iniciarVoz() {
    if (!reconhecimento) {
        mostrarNotificacao('Reconhecimento de voz não suportado', 'erro');
        return;
    }

    if (reconhecimentoVozAtivo) {
        reconhecimento.abort();
    } else {
        reconhecimento.start();
    }
}

function toggleTTS() {
    ttsAtivo = !ttsAtivo;
    document.getElementById('btnTTS').classList.toggle('ativo', ttsAtivo);
    mostrarNotificacao(`TTS ${ttsAtivo ? 'ativado' : 'desativado'}`, 'sucesso');
}

function falarTexto(texto) {
    if (!ttsAtivo) return;

    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(texto);
    utterance.lang = 'pt-BR';
    utterance.rate = configManager.config.tts.velocidade;

    // Tentar usar voz Francisca do Google
    const vozes = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
    const vozFrancisca = vozes.find(v => v.name.includes('Francisca') || v.name.includes('Google'));
    if (vozFrancisca) utterance.voice = vozFrancisca;

    speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

async function enviarMensagem() {
    const input = document.getElementById('inputChat');
    const mensagem = input.value.trim();

    if (!mensagem) return;

    if (!chatAtualId) {
        const novoChat = configManager.novoChat();
        chatAtualId = novoChat.id;
        atualizarHistorico();
    }

    // Adicionar mensagem do usuário
    adicionarMensagemUI('usuario', mensagem);
    configManager.salvarMensagemChat(chatAtualId, {
        tipo: 'usuario',
        conteudo: mensagem,
        timestamp: Date.now()
    });

    conversaAtual.push({ tipo: 'usuario', conteudo: mensagem });

    // Limpar input
    input.value = '';
    input.style.height = 'auto';

    // Desabilitar botão
    document.getElementById('btnEnviar').disabled = true;

    try {
        // Buscar internet se necessário
        let contextoInternet = '';
        if (configManager.config.buscaInternet === 'ativada') {
            const resultados = await gerenciadorIA.buscarInternet(mensagem);
            if (resultados.length > 0) {
                contextoInternet = '\n\nResultados de busca:\n' + 
                    resultados.map(r => `- ${r.title}: ${r.snippet}`).join('\n');
            }
        }

        // Preparar histórico com contexto de memória
        const memoriaContexto = configManager.obterMemoriaContexto(15);
        const historicoLimitado = conversaAtual.slice(-this.obterLimitContexto());

        // Enviar para IA
        const resposta = await gerenciadorIA.enviarMensagem(
            mensagem + contextoInternet,
            historicoLimitado
        );

        // Adicionar resposta da IA
        adicionarMensagemUI('ia', resposta);
        configManager.salvarMensagemChat(chatAtualId, {
            tipo: 'ia',
            conteudo: resposta,
            timestamp: Date.now()
        });

        conversaAtual.push({ tipo: 'ia', conteudo: resposta });

        // Falar resposta se TTS ativo
        falarTexto(resposta);

        // Adicionar à memória
        configManager.adicionarMemoria('conversa', `Usuário: ${mensagem}\nIA: ${resposta}`, 'chat');

    } catch (erro) {
        console.error('Erro:', erro);
        adicionarMensagemUI('erro', `Erro: ${erro.message}`);
        mostrarNotificacao('Erro ao processar mensagem', 'erro');
    } finally {
        document.getElementById('btnEnviar').disabled = false;
    }
}

function adicionarMensagemUI(tipo, conteudo) {
    const container = document.getElementById('mensagens');
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = `mensagem ${tipo}`;

    let conteudoHTML = conteudo;

    // Processar código
    if (conteudo.includes('```')) {
        conteudoHTML = processarCodigos(conteudo);
    } else {
        conteudoHTML = conteudo.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    }

    div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="mensagem-conteudo">
            ${conteudoHTML}
        </div>
        <div class="mensagem-toolbar">
            <button class="btn-msg" onclick="copiarMensagem(this)">📋 Copiar</button>
            ${tipo === 'ia' ? '<button class="btn-msg" onclick="fazerDownloadMensagem(this)">⬇️ Download</button>' : ''}
            ${tipo === 'ia' ? '<button class="btn-msg" onclick="falarTexto(\'' + conteudo.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\')">🔊 Falar</button>' : ''}
        </div>
    `;

    container.appendChild(div);
    container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

function processarCodigos(texto) {
    const regex = /```(\w+)?\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
    return texto.replace(regex, (match, linguagem, codigo) => {
        const lang = linguagem || 'text';
        return `
            <div class="codigo-bloco">
                <div class="codigo-toolbar">
                    <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary);">${lang}</span>
                    <button class="btn-codigo" onclick="copiarCodigo(this)">📋 Copiar</button>
                    <button class="btn-codigo" onclick="executarCodigo(this)">▶️ Executar</button>
                </div>
                <pre>${escapeHtml(codigo.trim())}</pre>
            </div>
        `;
    });
}

function escapeHtml(texto) {
    const map = {
        '&': '&amp;',
        '<': '&lt;',
        '>': '&gt;',
        '"': '&quot;',
        "'": '&#039;'
    };
    return texto.replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => map[m]);
}

function copiarMensagem(btn) {
    const conteudo = btn.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('.mensagem-conteudo').innerText;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(conteudo).then(() => {
        mostrarNotificacao('Copiado!', 'sucesso');
    });
}

function copiarCodigo(btn) {
    const codigo = btn.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('pre').innerText;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(codigo).then(() => {
        mostrarNotificacao('Código copiado!', 'sucesso');
    });
}

function fazerDownloadMensagem(btn) {
    const conteudo = btn.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('.mensagem-conteudo').innerText;
    const blob = new Blob([conteudo], { type: 'text/markdown' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `mensagem-${Date.now()}.md`;
    a.click();
}

function executarCodigo(btn) {
    const codigo = btn.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('pre').innerText;
    document.getElementById('playgroundCodigo').value = codigo;
    abrirPlayground();
    executarPlayground();
}

function obterLimitContexto() {
    const contexto = configManager.config.contexto;
    const limites = { 'curto': 5, 'medio': 10, 'longo': 20 };
    return limites[contexto] || 10;
}

function novoChat() {
    const novoChat = configManager.novoChat();
    chatAtualId = novoChat.id;
    conversaAtual = [];
    document.getElementById('mensagens').innerHTML = '';
    atualizarHistorico();
    mostrarNotificacao('Novo chat criado', 'sucesso');
}

function atualizarHistorico() {
    const container = document.getElementById('historico');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    configManager.chats.forEach(chat => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = `chat-item ${chat.id === chatAtualId ? 'ativo' : ''}`;
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                <span>${chat.titulo}</span>
                <button onclick="excluirChat(${chat.id})" style="background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer;">✕</button>
            </div>
        `;
        div.onclick = () => carregarChat(chat.id);
        container.appendChild(div);
    });
}

function carregarChat(id) {
    const chat = configManager.obterChat(id);
    if (chat) {
        chatAtualId = id;
        conversaAtual = chat.mensagens;
        document.getElementById('mensagens').innerHTML = '';
        chat.mensagens.forEach(msg => {
            adicionarMensagemUI(msg.tipo, msg.conteudo);
        });
        atualizarHistorico();
    }
}

function excluirChat(id) {
    if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir este chat?')) {
        configManager.chats = configManager.chats.filter(c => c.id !== id);
        configManager.salvarChats();
        if (chatAtualId === id) {
            chatAtualId = null;
            conversaAtual = [];
            document.getElementById('mensagens').innerHTML = '';
        }
        atualizarHistorico();
        mostrarNotificacao('Chat excluído', 'sucesso');
    }
}

function atualizarModelo() {
    const modelo = document.getElementById('selectModelo').value;
    configManager.config.modelo = modelo;
    configManager.salvarConfig();
    mostrarNotificacao(`Modelo alterado para ${modelo}`, 'sucesso');
}

function atualizarConfig() {
    configManager.config.temperatura = parseFloat(document.getElementById('temperatura').value);
    configManager.config.maxTokens = parseInt(document.getElementById('maxTokens').value);
    configManager.config.contexto = document.getElementById('contexto').value;
    configManager.config.buscaInternet = document.getElementById('buscaInternet').value;
    configManager.config.tamanhoResposta = document.getElementById('tamanhoResposta').value;

    document.getElementById('tempValor').innerText = configManager.config.temperatura;
    document.getElementById('tokenValor').innerText = configManager.config.maxTokens;

    configManager.salvarConfig();
}

function mostrarNotificacao(mensagem, tipo = 'info') {
    const notif = document.createElement('div');
    notif.style.cssText = `
        position: fixed;
        top: 20px;
        right: 20px;
        padding: 15px 20px;
        background: ${tipo === 'sucesso' ? '#10b981' : tipo === 'erro' ? '#ef4444' : '#2563eb'};
        color: white;
        border-radius: 8px;
        z-index: 10000;
        animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
    `;
    notif.innerText = mensagem;
    document.body.appendChild(notif);

    setTimeout(() => notif.remove(), 3000);
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Chat IA Profissional - Monica & Modelos</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #2563eb;
            --secondary: #1e40af;
            --accent: #f59e0b;
            --bg-dark: #0f172a;
            --bg-light: #1e293b;
            --text-primary: #f1f5f9;
            --text-secondary: #cbd5e1;
            --border: #334155;
            --success: #10b981;
            --warning: #ef4444;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .container-main {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr;
            height: 100vh;
            gap: 0;
        }

        /* SIDEBAR */
        .sidebar {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 15px;
        }

        .sidebar-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .sidebar-header h1 {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .btn-novo-chat {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            background: var(--primary);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .btn-novo-chat:hover {
            background: var(--secondary);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .historico-chats {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .chat-item {
            padding: 12px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
        }

        .chat-item:hover {
            background: var(--border);
            border-left-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .chat-item.ativo {
            background: var(--primary);
            border-left-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .sidebar-footer {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .btn-sidebar {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 80px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 12px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-sidebar:hover {
            background: var(--border);
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        /* MAIN CONTENT */
        .main-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
        }

        /* HEADER CONFIGURAÇÃO */
        .config-header {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 15px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 12px;
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .config-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .config-item label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .config-item select,
        .config-item input {
            padding: 8px 12px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .config-item input[type="range"] {
            padding: 0;
            height: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        /* CHAT AREA */
        .chat-container {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .mensagens {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 15px;
        }

        .mensagem {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .mensagem.usuario {
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }

        .mensagem-conteudo {
            max-width: 70%;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            word-wrap: break-word;
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .mensagem.usuario .mensagem-conteudo {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
        }

        .mensagem.ia .mensagem-conteudo {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
        }

        .mensagem-toolbar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 8px;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.2s;
        }

        .mensagem:hover .mensagem-toolbar {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .btn-msg {
            padding: 6px 10px;
            background: var(--border);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 11px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-msg:hover {
            background: var(--primary);
        }

        /* INPUT AREA */
        .input-area {
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            align-items: flex-end;
        }

        .input-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .input-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .btn-control {
            padding: 8px 12px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 12px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-control:hover {
            background: var(--primary);
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .btn-control.ativo {
            background: var(--success);
            border-color: var(--success);
        }

        #inputChat {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-family: inherit;
            resize: none;
            max-height: 100px;
            min-height: 44px;
        }

        #inputChat:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);
        }

        .btn-enviar {
            padding: 12px 20px;
            background: var(--primary);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            min-width: 100px;
        }

        .btn-enviar:hover:not(:disabled) {
            background: var(--secondary);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-enviar:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* MODALS */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            z-index: 1000;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .modal.ativo {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 30px;
            max-width: 600px;
            width: 90%;
            max-height: 80vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .modal-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .modal-header h2 {
            font-size: 20px;
        }

        .btn-fechar {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 24px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .form-group label {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .form-group input,
        .form-group textarea,
        .form-group select {
            padding: 12px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .form-group textarea {
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 100px;
        }

        .btn-salvar {
            padding: 12px 24px;
            background: var(--success);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-salvar:hover {
            background: #059669;
        }

        /* TABS */
        .tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .tab {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .tab:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .tab.ativo {
            color: var(--primary);
            border-bottom-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .tab-content {
            display: none;
        }

        .tab-content.ativo {
            display: block;
        }

        /* RESPONSIVO */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container-main {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .sidebar {
                display: none;
                position: fixed;
                left: 0;
                top: 0;
                bottom: 0;
                width: 280px;
                z-index: 999;
            }

            .sidebar.ativo {
                display: flex;
            }

            .config-header {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .mensagem-conteudo {
                max-width: 85%;
            }

            .modal-content {
                width: 95%;
                padding: 20px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .config-header {
                padding: 10px;
                gap: 8px;
            }

            .config-item select,
            .config-item input {
                font-size: 12px;
                padding: 6px 10px;
            }

            .mensagem-conteudo {
                max-width: 95%;
                padding: 10px 12px;
                font-size: 14px;
            }

            .input-area {
                padding: 12px;
                gap: 8px;
            }

            .btn-enviar {
                min-width: 80px;
                padding: 10px 16px;
            }

            .sidebar-header h1 {
                font-size: 14px;
            }
        }

        /* SCROLLBAR CUSTOMIZADO */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--border);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: var(--primary);
        }

        /* CÓDIGO HIGHLIGHT */
        .codigo-bloco {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px;
            margin: 10px 0;
            overflow-x: auto;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .codigo-toolbar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .btn-codigo {
            padding: 6px 12px;
            background: var(--primary);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 11px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-codigo:hover {
            background: var(--secondary);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container-main">
        <!-- SIDEBAR -->
        <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
            <div class="sidebar-header">
                <span>🧠</span>
                <h1>Chat IA</h1>
            </div>

            <button class="btn-novo-chat" onclick="novoChat()">+ Novo Chat</button>

            <div class="historico-chats" id="historico"></div>

            <div class="sidebar-footer">
                <button class="btn-sidebar" onclick="abrirConfiguracoes()">⚙️ Config</button>
                <button class="btn-sidebar" onclick="abrirMemoria()">💾 Memória</button>
                <button class="btn-sidebar" onclick="fazerBackup()">📦 Backup</button>
                <button class="btn-sidebar" onclick="importarBackup()">📥 Importar</button>
            </div>
        </aside>

        <!-- MAIN CONTENT -->
        <main class="main-content">
            <!-- HEADER CONFIGURAÇÃO -->
            <div class="config-header">
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label>Modelo IA</label>
                    <select id="selectModelo" onchange="atualizarModelo()">
                        <option value="monica">Monica API</option>
                        <option value="openai">OpenAI</option>
                        <option value="claude">Claude</option>
                        <option value="gemini">Google Gemini</option>
                        <option value="local">IA Local</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="config-item">
                    <label>Temperatura</label>
                    <input type="range" id="temperatura" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="0.7" onchange="atualizarConfig()">
                    <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary);" id="tempValor">0.7</span>
                </div>

                <div class="config-item">
                    <label>Max Tokens</label>
                    <input type="range" id="maxTokens" min="100" max="4000" step="100" value="2000" onchange="atualizarConfig()">
                    <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary);" id="tokenValor">2000</span>
                </div>

                <div class="config-item">
                    <label>Contexto</label>
                    <select id="contexto" onchange="atualizarConfig()">
                        <option value="curto">Curto (5 msg)</option>
                        <option value="medio" selected>Médio (10 msg)</option>
                        <option value="longo">Longo (20 msg)</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="config-item">
                    <label>Busca Internet</label>
                    <select id="buscaInternet" onchange="atualizarConfig()">
                        <option value="desativada">Desativada</option>
                        <option value="ativada">Ativada</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="config-item">
                    <label>Tamanho Resposta</label>
                    <select id="tamanhoResposta" onchange="atualizarConfig()">
                        <option value="curta">Curta</option>
                        <option value="media" selected>Média</option>
                        <option value="longa">Longa</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- CHAT CONTAINER -->
            <div class="chat-container">
                <div class="mensagens" id="mensagens"></div>

                <!-- INPUT AREA -->
                <div class="input-area">
                    <div class="input-wrapper">
                        <div class="input-controls">
                            <button class="btn-control" id="btnVoz" onclick="iniciarVoz()" title="Reconhecimento de voz">🎤</button>
                            <button class="btn-control" id="btnTTS" onclick="toggleTTS()" title="Ativar TTS">🔊</button>
                            <button class="btn-control" onclick="abrirPlayground()" title="Playground">▶️</button>
                            <button class="btn-control" onclick="anexarArquivo()" title="Anexar arquivo">📎</button>
                        </div>
                        <textarea id="inputChat" placeholder="Digite sua mensagem..." rows="1"></textarea>
                    </div>
                    <button class="btn-enviar" id="btnEnviar" onclick="enviarMensagem()">Enviar</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </main>
    </div>

    <!-- MODALS -->
    <div class="modal" id="modalConfig">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h2>⚙️ Configurações</h2>
                <button class="btn-fechar" onclick="fecharModal('modalConfig')">✕</button>
            </div>

            <div class="tabs">
                <button class="tab ativo" onclick="mudarTab('chaves')">Chaves API</button>
                <button class="tab" onclick="mudarTab('prompts')">Prompts</button>
                <button class="tab" onclick="mudarTab('perfil')">Perfil Usuário</button>
                <button class="tab" onclick="mudarTab('local')">IA Local</button>
            </div>

            <!-- TAB: CHAVES -->
            <div class="tab-content ativo" id="tab-chaves">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Chave OpenAI</label>
                    <input type="password" id="chaveOpenAI" placeholder="sk-...">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Chave Google Gemini</label>
                    <input type="password" id="chaveGemini" placeholder="AIza...">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Chave Monica</label>
                    <input type="password" id="chaveMonica" placeholder="Sua chave Monica">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Chave Busca Internet</label>
                    <input type="password" id="chaveBusca" placeholder="Chave de busca">
                </div>
                <button class="btn-salvar" onclick="salvarChaves()">Salvar Chaves</button>
            </div>

            <!-- TAB: PROMPTS -->
            <div class="tab-content" id="tab-prompts">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Prompt Sistema</label>
                    <textarea id="promptSistema" placeholder="Defina o comportamento da IA..."></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Instruções Adicionais</label>
                    <textarea id="instrucoesAdicionais" placeholder="Instruções específicas..."></textarea>
                </div>
                <button class="btn-salvar" onclick="salvarPrompts()">Salvar Prompts</button>
            </div>

            <!-- TAB: PERFIL -->
            <div class="tab-content" id="tab-perfil">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Nome</label>
                    <input type="text" id="nomeUsuario" placeholder="Seu nome">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Profissão/Área</label>
                    <input type="text" id="profissao" placeholder="Ex: Advogado, Desenvolvedor...">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Interesses</label>
                    <textarea id="interesses" placeholder="Seus interesses e preferências..."></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Personalidade Desejada da IA</label>
                    <textarea id="personalidadeIA" placeholder="Como você quer que a IA se comporte..."></textarea>
                </div>
                <button class="btn-salvar" onclick="salvarPerfil()">Salvar Perfil</button>
            </div>

            <!-- TAB: IA LOCAL -->
            <div class="tab-content" id="tab-local">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Endereço Local (localhost:porta)</label>
                    <input type="text" id="enderecoLocal" placeholder="http://localhost:8000">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Modelo Local</label>
                    <input type="text" id="modeloLocal" placeholder="Ex: llama2, mistral">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Status</label>
                    <button class="btn-control" onclick="testarConexaoLocal()">🔗 Testar Conexão</button>
                    <span id="statusLocal" style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px;"></span>
                </div>
                <button class="btn-salvar" onclick="salvarConfigLocal()">Salvar Config Local</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODAL MEMÓRIA -->
    <div class="modal" id="modalMemoria">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h2>💾 Gerenciador de Memória</h2>
                <button class="btn-fechar" onclick="fecharModal('modalMemoria')">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div id="listaMemoria" style="max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto;"></div>
            <button class="btn-salvar" onclick="limparMemoria()" style="margin-top: 15px; background: var(--warning);">Limpar Memória</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODAL PLAYGROUND -->
    <div class="modal" id="modalPlayground">
        <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 900px;">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h2>▶️ Playground</h2>
                <button class="btn-fechar" onclick="fecharModal('modalPlayground')">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 15px; height: 500px;">
                <div>
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 600;">Código</label>
                    <textarea id="playgroundCodigo" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 12px; background: var(--bg-dark); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-primary); font-family: 'Courier New'; font-size: 12px;"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 600;">Preview</label>
                    <iframe id="playgroundPreview" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: white;"></iframe>
                </div>
            </div>
            <button class="btn-salvar" onclick="executarPlayground()" style="margin-top: 15px;">▶️ Executar</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>



<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0d1117">
<title>Iara Suite</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0d1117;--bg2:#161b22;--bg3:#21262d;--text:#e6edf3;--muted:#8b949e;--primary:#58a6ff;--green:#3fb950;--red:#f85149}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#nav{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 15px;height:50px;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-logo{font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
.nav-logo span{color:var(--primary)}
.tab-btn{background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;transition:.2s}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--primary);border-bottom:2px solid var(--primary)}
#panels{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex}
.panel{display:none;flex:1;overflow:hidden;flex-direction:column}
.panel.active{display:flex}
#editor-panel{flex-direction:row}
#ed-sidebar{width:200px;background:var(--bg2);border-right:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#file-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px}
.file-item{padding:8px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;transition:.1s;margin-bottom:2px}
.file-item:hover{background:var(--bg3)}
.file-item.active{background:var(--primary);color:#000}
#ed-main{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#ed-toolbar{padding:10px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
#ed-work{flex:1;display:flex;overflow:hidden}
#code-ta{flex:1;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);border:none;padding:15px;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;resize:none;outline:none}
#preview-wrap{flex:1;border-left:1px solid #30363d;background:#fff;display:none}
#preview-wrap.show{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#preview-frame{flex:1;border:none}
#ai-panel{width:300px;background:var(--bg2);border-left:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#ai-panel.hidden{display:none}
#ai-msgs{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.ai-msg{padding:8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.ai-msg.user{background:var(--primary);color:#000}
.ai-msg.assistant{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
#ai-ta{width:100%;height:60px;padding:8px;background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);border:none;font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;resize:none}
.btn{padding:6px 12px;background:var(--primary);color:#000;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.btn:hover{opacity:.8}
.btn.secondary{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
input,select{padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px}
.modal{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.8);z-index:900;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.modal.open{display:flex}
.modal-box{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;padding:20px;width:90%;max-width:600px;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto}
#mapper-panel{overflow-y:auto;padding:20px}
.card{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:15px}
.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(80px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0}
.stat-tile{background:var(--bg3);padding:10px;border-radius:4px;text-align:center;font-size:11px}
.stat-num{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav id="nav">
  <div class="nav-logo">⚡ <span>Iara</span></div>
  <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="editor">💻 Editor</button>
  <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="mapper">🗺️ Mapa</button>
  <div style="flex:1"></div>
  <button class="btn secondary" onclick="openKeysModal()">🔑 Chaves</button>
</nav>

<div id="panels">
  <div class="panel active" id="editor-panel">
    <div id="ed-sidebar">
      <div style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d">
        <input id="nfi" type="text" placeholder="novo arquivo" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')newFile()" style="width:100%">
      </div>
      <div id="file-list"></div>
      <div style="padding:8px;border-top:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;gap:4px">
        <button class="btn secondary" style="flex:1;font-size:10px" onclick="qs('#zip-import').click()">📥 ZIP</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" style="flex:1;font-size:10px" onclick="exportZip()">📤 ZIP</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="ed-main">
      <div id="ed-toolbar">
        <input id="ed-fname" type="text" value="sem arquivo" onblur="renameFile()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')renameFile()">
        <span id="lbadge" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)"></span>
        <div style="flex:1"></div>
        <button class="btn secondary" style="font-size:10px" onclick="setPM('off')" id="pm-off">📝</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" style="font-size:10px" onclick="setPM('split')" id="pm-split">⚡</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" style="font-size:10px" onclick="setPM('full')" id="pm-full">🔲</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" style="font-size:10px" onclick="saveFile()">💾</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" style="font-size:10px" onclick="toggleAI()">🤖</button>
      </div>
      <div id="ed-work">
        <textarea id="code-ta" placeholder="Selecione um arquivo..." oninput="onCodeInput()" onkeydown="codeKD(event)"></textarea>
        <div id="preview-wrap">
          <div style="padding:8px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;gap:8px">
            <span id="prev-lbl" style="font-size:11px;flex:1">Preview</span>
            <button class="btn secondary" style="font-size:10px;padding:4px 8px" onclick="refreshPreview()">🔄</button>
          </div>
          <iframe id="preview-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="ai-panel" class="hidden">
      <div style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d">
        <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600">🤖 Jasmim</div>
        <div id="ai-prov" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px">Nenhuma chave</div>
      </div>
      <div id="ai-msgs"></div>
      <div style="padding:8px;border-top:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px">
        <textarea id="ai-ta" placeholder="Digite..."></textarea>
        <button class="btn" style="width:100%" onclick="sendAI()">Enviar</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="panel" id="mapper-panel">
    <h2>🗺️ Mapa do Projeto</h2>
    <div class="card">
      <div style="margin-bottom:10px">
        <input type="file" id="map-file" accept=".zip" onchange="runMap(event)">
      </div>
      <div id="map-results"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal" id="keys-modal">
  <div class="modal-box">
    <h3>🔑 Chaves de API</h3>
    <div id="slots-wrap"></div>
    <button class="btn" style="width:100%;margin-top:15px" onclick="saveKeys()">Salvar</button>
  </div>
</div>

<input type="file" id="zip-import" accept=".zip" style="display:none" onchange="handleZipImport(event)">

<script>
var qs=function(s){return document.querySelector(s)};
var qsa=function(s){return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s))};
var ls=function(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return null}};
var lsSet=function(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}};
var esc=function(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')};

var files={},curFile=null,prevMode='off',aiHistory=[],slots=[{name:'Slot 1',key:'',model:'',active:false},{name:'Slot 2',key:'',model:'',active:false},{name:'Slot 3',key:'',model:'',active:false},{name:'Slot 4',key:'',model:'',active:false}];

function toast(msg){var el=document.createElement('div');el.textContent=msg;el.style.cssText='position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:var(--green);color:#000;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:4px;z-index:9999;font-size:12px';document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(function(){el.remove()},2000)}

function getExt(p){return(p.split('.').pop()||'').toLowerCase()}

function FICON(n){var m={html:'🌐',css:'🎨',js:'📜',jsx:'⚛',ts:'📘',tsx:'⚛',json:'📋',md:'📝',txt:'📄',py:'🐍',java:'☕',php:'🐘',sh:'⚙',zip:'📦'};return m[getExt(n)]||'📄'}

function initEditor(){
  var saved=ls('iara-files');
  if(saved)try{files=JSON.parse(saved)}catch(e){}
  if(!Object.keys(files).length){
    files['index.html']='<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n<head><title>App</title><style>body{font-family:sans-serif;background:#0f172a;color:#e2e8f0;padding:20px}h1{color:#58a6ff}</style></head>\n<body><h1>Iara Suite</h1><p>Preview ao vivo!</p></body>\n</html>';
    files['README.md']='# Iara Suite\n\nEditor com preview.\nCtrl+S = salvar';
  }
  renderFiles();
  var first=Object.keys(files)[0];
  if(first)openFile(first);
  slots=JSON.parse(ls('iara-slots')||'null')||slots;
  updateProvInfo();
}

function renderFiles(){
  var h='';
  Object.keys(files).forEach(function(f){
    h+='<div class="file-item '+(f===curFile?'active':'')+'" onclick="openFile(\''+f.replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\')" title="'+f+'">'+FICON(f)+' '+f.slice(0,20)+'</div>';
  });
  qs('#file-list').innerHTML=h;
}

function openFile(name){
  if(curFile&&files[curFile])files[curFile]=qs('#code-ta').value;
  curFile=name;
  qs('#code-ta').value=files[name]||'';
  qs('#ed-fname').value=name;
  qs('#lbadge').textContent=getExt(name)||'txt';
  renderFiles();
  if(prevMode!=='off')refreshPreview();
}

function saveFile(){
  if(!curFile)return;
  files[curFile]=qs('#code-ta').value;
  lsSet('iara-files',JSON.stringify(files));
  toast('💾 Salvo!');
}

function newFile(){
  var n=(qs('#nfi').value||'').trim();
  if(!n||files[n])return;
  files[n]='';
  qs('#nfi').value='';
  renderFiles();
  openFile(n);
  saveFile();
}

function renameFile(){
  var nn=(qs('#ed-fname').value||'').trim();
  if(!nn||nn===curFile)return;
  if(files[nn]){alert('Já existe');qs('#ed-fname').value=curFile;return}
  files[nn]=files[curFile];
  delete files[curFile];
  curFile=nn;
  renderFiles();
  lsSet('iara-files',JSON.stringify(files));
  toast('✏️ Renomeado!');
}

function onCodeInput(){
  if(curFile)files[curFile]=qs('#code-ta').value;
  if(prevMode!=='off'&&getExt(curFile||'')==='html'){
    clearTimeout(window.prevTimer);
    window.prevTimer=setTimeout(refreshPreview,500);
  }
}

function codeKD(e){
  if(e.key==='Tab'){
    e.preventDefault();
    var ta=e.target;
    var s=ta.selectionStart;
    ta.value=ta.value.slice(0,s)+'  '+ta.value.slice(s);
    ta.selectionStart=s+2;
  }
  if(e.key==='s'&&(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)){e.preventDefault();saveFile()}
  if(e.key==='Enter'&&(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&prevMode==='off'){e.preventDefault();toggleAI()}
}

function setPM(mode){
  prevMode=mode;
  qsa('#ed-toolbar .btn').forEach(function(b){b.style.background='var(--bg3)';b.style.color='var(--text)'});
  qs('#pm-'+mode).style.background='var(--primary)';
  qs('#pm-'+mode).style.color='#000';
  var pw=qs('#preview-wrap');
  if(mode==='off'){pw.classList.remove('show')}
  else{pw.classList.add('show');refreshPreview()}
}

function refreshPreview(){
  if(!curFile)return;
  var ext=getExt(curFile);
  var frame=qs('#preview-frame');
  var lbl=qs('#prev-lbl');
  if(ext==='html'){
    lbl.textContent='🟢 '+curFile;
    frame.srcdoc=files[curFile]||'';
  }else if(ext==='md'){
    lbl.textContent='📝 '+curFile;
    frame.srcdoc='<pre style="padding:20px;font-family:monospace;white-space:pre-wrap">'+esc(files[curFile]||'')+'</pre>';
  }else{
    lbl.textContent='📄 '+curFile;
    frame.srcdoc='<pre style="padding:20px;font-family:monospace">'+esc(files[curFile]||'')+'</pre>';
  }
}

async function handleZipImport(e){
  var f=e.target.files[0];
  if(!f||!window.JSZip)return;
  var z=await JSZip.loadAsync(f);
  var nf={};
  Object.keys(z.files).forEach(function(p){
    if(!z.files[p].dir){
      z.files[p].async('string').then(function(c){nf[p]=c;if(Object.keys(nf).length===Object.keys(z.files).length-Object.keys(z.files).filter(function(x){return z.files[x].dir}).length){files=nf;renderFiles();openFile(Object.keys(files)[0]);toast('📥 '+Object.keys(files).length+' arquivos')}})
    }
  });
  e.target.value='';
}

async function exportZip(){
  if(!Object.keys(files).length)return;
  if(curFile)files[curFile]=qs('#code-ta').value;
  var z=new JSZip();
  Object.keys(files).forEach(function(n){z.file(n,files[n]||'')});
  var blob=await z.generateAsync({type:'blob'});
  var a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download='projeto.zip';
  a.click();
  toast('📤 ZIP exportado!');
}

/* AI */
var DETECT=function(key){
  var k=(key||'').trim();
  if(k.indexOf('sk-ant-')===0)return{p:'anthropic',m:'claude-haiku-4-20250514'};
  if(k.indexOf('AIza')===0)return{p:'google',m:'gemini-2.0-flash'};
  if(k.indexOf('sk-or-')===0)return{p:'compat',m:'anthropic/claude-haiku',u:'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'};
  if(k.indexOf('gsk_')===0)return{p:'compat',m:'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',u:'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1'};
  if(k.indexOf('sk-')===0)return{p:'compat',m:'gpt-4o-mini',u:'https://api.openai.com/v1'};
  return null;
};

function getActive(){for(var i=0;i<slots.length;i++){if(slots[i].active&&slots[i].key)return slots[i]}return null}

function updateProvInfo(){
  var s=getActive();
  var el=qs('#ai-prov');
  if(s){var d=DETECT(s.key);el.textContent=(d?d.p:'custom')+' · '+(s.model||d.m||'auto')}
  else el.textContent='Nenhuma chave ativa';
}

function toggleAI(){qs('#ai-panel').classList.toggle('hidden')}

function addMsg(role,text){
  var el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='ai-msg '+role;
  el.textContent=text;
  el.style.maxHeight='200px';
  el.style.overflowY='auto';
  qs('#ai-msgs').appendChild(el);
  qs('#ai-msgs').scrollTop=qs('#ai-msgs').scrollHeight;
}

async function sendAI(){
  var msg=(qs('#ai-ta').value||'').trim();
  if(!msg)return;
  var s=getActive();
  if(!s){alert('Configure uma chave API');return}
  addMsg('user',msg);
  qs('#ai-ta').value='';
  aiHistory.push({role:'user',content:msg});
  if(aiHistory.length>20)aiHistory=aiHistory.slice(-20);
  var thinking=document.createElement('div');
  thinking.className='ai-msg assistant';
  thinking.textContent='⏳ Processando...';
  qs('#ai-msgs').appendChild(thinking);
  qs('#ai-msgs').scrollTop=qs('#ai-msgs').scrollHeight;
  try{
    var d=DETECT(s.key);
    var base=(s.baseUrl||d.u||'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/$/,'');
    var r=await fetch(base+'/chat/completions',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+s.key},
      body:JSON.stringify({model:s.model||d.m,messages:[{role:'system',content:'Você é um assistente de programação. Responda em português.'}].concat(aiHistory),max_tokens:1000,temperature:0.7})
    });
    var j=await r.json();
    var reply=j.choices[0].message.content;
    thinking.textContent=reply;
    aiHistory.push({role:'assistant',content:reply});
  }catch(err){
    thinking.textContent='❌ '+err.message;
  }
}

function openKeysModal(){
  renderSlots();
  qs('#keys-modal').classList.add('open');
}

function renderSlots(){
  var h='';
  for(var i=0;i<slots.length;i++){
    h+='<div style="margin-bottom:15px;padding:10px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:4px">';
    h+='<div style="margin-bottom:8px"><label style="font-size:11px">Slot '+(i+1)+' <input type="checkbox" id="sa-'+i+'" '+(slots[i].active?'checked':'')+' style="margin-left:8px"></label></div>';
    h+='<input type="password" id="sk-'+i+'" value="'+slots[i].key+'" placeholder="sk-... ou gsk_..." style="width:100%;margin-bottom:6px">';
    h+='<input type="text" id="sm-'+i+'" value="'+slots[i].model+'" placeholder="Modelo (opcional)" style="width:100%">';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  qs('#slots-wrap').innerHTML=h;
}

function saveKeys(){
  for(var i=0;i<slots.length;i++){
    slots[i].key=qs('#sk-'+i).value;
    slots[i].model=qs('#sm-'+i).value;
    slots[i].active=qs('#sa-'+i).checked;
  }
  lsSet('iara-slots',JSON.stringify(slots));
  updateProvInfo();
  qs('#keys-modal').classList.remove('open');
  toast('✅ Chaves salvas!');
}

function closeKeysModal(){qs('#keys-modal').classList.remove('open')}

/* MAPPER */
async function runMap(e){
  var f=e.target.files[0];
  if(!f||!window.JSZip)return;
  var z=await JSZip.loadAsync(f);
  var files_list=[];
  Object.keys(z.files).forEach(function(p){
    if(!z.files[p].dir)files_list.push(p);
  });
  var h='<div class="stat-grid">';
  h+='<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-num">'+files_list.length+'</div><div>Arquivos</div></div>';
  h+='</div>';
  h+='<div style="margin-top:10px"><strong>Arquivos:</strong><br>';
  files_list.slice(0,20).forEach(function(p){h+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">'+p+'</div>'});
  if(files_list.length>20)h+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">... e '+(files_list.length-20)+' mais</div>';
  h+='</div>';
  qs('#map-results').innerHTML=h;
  e.target.value='';
}

/* TABS */
qsa('.tab-btn').forEach(function(b){
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){
    qsa('.tab-btn').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('active')});
    qsa('.panel').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('active')});
    b.classList.add('active');
    var panel=qs('#'+b.dataset.tab+'-panel');
    if(panel)panel.classList.add('active');
  });
});

/* MODAL */
qs('#keys-modal').addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===this)closeKeysModal()});

/* INIT */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initEditor);
</script>

</body>
</html>


<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>🚀 Guia Interativo - Chat IA Profissional</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%);
            color: #e2e8f0;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            padding: 30px 0;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #2563eb;
        }

        header h1 {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #7c3aed);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        header p {
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-size: 1.1em;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            background: #334155;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2563eb, #7c3aed);
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .steps-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .steps-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        .step {
            background: #1e293b;
            border: 2px solid #334155;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        .step:hover {
            border-color: #2563eb;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2);
        }

        .step.ativo {
            border-color: #2563eb;
            background: #0f172a;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
        }

        .step.completo {
            border-color: #10b981;
        }

        .step-numero {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            background: #2563eb;
            border-radius: 50%;
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 40px;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 1.2em;
        }

        .step.completo .step-numero {
            background: #10b981;
        }

        .step h3 {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            color: #f1f5f9;
        }

        .step p {
            color: #cbd5e1;
            font-size: 0.95em;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .step-status {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.85em;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .status-pendente {
            background: #334155;
            color: #cbd5e1;
        }

        .status-ativo {
            background: #2563eb;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .status-completo {
            background: #10b981;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .conteudo-step {
            background: #0f172a;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            display: none;
        }

        .conteudo-step.ativo {
            display: block;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {

            to {

        .checklist-item {

</head>

cd chat-ia-profissional
mkdir icons
mkdir screenshots
mkdir docs</pre>

                    <div class="checklist">
                        <h4 style="color: #2563eb; margin-bottom: 10px;">✓ Checklist</h4>
                        <div class="checklist-item">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="check1-1">
                            <label for="check1-1">Pasta criada e navegada</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="checklist-item">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="check1-2">
                            <label for="check1-2">Subpastas criadas (/icons, /screenshots, /docs)</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="checklist-item">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="check1-3">
                            <label for="check1-3">Servidor local rodando</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="checklist-item">
                            <input type="checkbox" id="check1-4">
                            <label for="check1-4">Navegador aberto em http://localhost:8000</label>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="botoes-acao">

            {
                numero: 2,
                titulo: '📄 Criar index.html',
                descricao: 'Arquivo HTML com CSS responsivo',
                tempo: '5 min',
                conteudo: `
                    <div class="instrucoes">
                        <h4>📝 Criar Arquivo</h4>
                        <p>Crie um novo arquivo chamado <strong>index.html</strong> na raiz do projeto</p>
                    </div>
