      <code>ap-</code> Mistral · <code>ds-</code> DeepSeek
    </div>
    <div id="slots-wrap"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px" onclick="saveKeys()">✅ Salvar e Fechar</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="code-modal" id="code-modal">
  <div class="code-box">
    <div class="code-box-head">
      <span id="cm-title" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)">Código</span>
      <div class="flex" style="gap:5px">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary" style="font-size:10px;padding:3px 9px" onclick="copyText(qs('#cm-body').textContent)">📋</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="font-size:12px;padding:3px 8px" onclick="qs('#code-modal').classList.remove('open')">✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="code-box-body"><pre id="cm-body"></pre></div>
  </div>
</div>
<input type="file" id="zip-import" accept=".zip" style="display:none" onchange="handleZipImport(event)">


// ==================== PROVIDER / MODEL ====================
function onProviderChange() {
    updateModelSelect();
}

function updateModelSelect() {
    const provider = document.getElementById('aiProvider').value;
    const select = document.getElementById('modelSelect');
    const models = MODELS[provider] || [];
    select.innerHTML = models.map(m => `<option value="${m}">${m}</option>`).join('');

    // Restore saved model if same provider
    if (state.settings.provider === provider && state.settings.model) {
        const exists = models.includes(state.settings.model);
        if (exists) select.value = state.settings.model;
    }
}

// ==================== PASTE CODE ====================
async function pasteCode() {
    try {
        const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
        if (!text) { showToast('Área de transferência vazia', 'error'); return; }

        // Detecta se parece código
        const looksLikeCode = /[{}();=><\/\\]/.test(text) || text.includes('def ') || text.includes('function ');

        if (looksLikeCode) {
            // Pergunta se vai pro editor ou pro chat
            const toEditor = confirm('Parece código!\n\nOK = Colar no Editor de Código\nCancelar = Colar no Chat');
            if (toEditor) {
                document.getElementById('codeEditor').value = text;
                saveCurrentCodeTab();
                showToast('✅ Código colado no editor!', 'success');
                return;
            }
        }

        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        input.value += text;
        autoResize(input);
        showToast('✅ Colado no chat!', 'success');
    } catch(e) {
        showToast('❌ Sem permissão para acessar clipboard', 'error');
    }
}

// ==================== EXPORT ====================
function exportAll() {
    const data = {
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        conversations: state.conversations,
        codeTabs: state.codeTabs,
        settings: { ...state.settings, apiKey: '***', serperKey: '***' }
    };

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `ai-studio-backup-${Date.now()}.json`;
    a.click();
    showToast('💾 Backup exportado!', 'success');
}

// ==================== UI HELPERS ====================
function toggleCodePanel() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('codePanel');
    panel.classList.toggle('hidden');
}

function handleKey(e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        sendMessage();
    }
    // Tab no textarea = inserir espaços
    if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const ta = e.target;
        const start = ta.selectionStart;
        const end = ta.selectionEnd;
        ta.value = ta.value.substring(0, start) + '  ' + ta.value.substring(end);
        ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = start + 2;
    }
}

function autoResize(el) {
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = Math.min(el.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
}

function showToast(msg, type = '') {
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.className = 'toast show ' + type;
    clearTimeout(toast._timer);
    toast._timer = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.className = 'toast';
    }, 3000);
}

// Fecha modal clicando fora
document.getElementById('settingsModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) closeSettings();
});

// Salva código ao digitar
document.getElementById('codeEditor').addEventListener('input', () => {
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
});

// Salva provider/model ao mudar
document.getElementById('modelSelect').addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.settings.model = document.getElementById('modelSelect').value;
    saveToStorage();
});

// ==================== START ====================
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>


<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AI Code Studio</title>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        
        :root {
            --bg: #0d1117;
            --bg2: #161b22;
            --bg3: #21262d;
            --border: #30363d;
            --text: #c9d1d9;
            --text2: #8b949e;
            --accent: #58a6ff;
            --green: #3fb950;
            --red: #f85149;
            --yellow: #d29922;
            --purple: #bc8cff;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* HEADER */
        .header {
            background: var(--bg2);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 10px 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .header h1 {
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .header-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            flex: 1;
        }

        select, input[type="text"], input[type="password"], input[type="number"] {
            background: var(--bg3);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 5px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 13px;
            outline: none;
        }

        select:focus, input:focus {
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--bg3);
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 13px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .btn:hover { background: var(--border); }
        .btn.primary { background: var(--accent); color: #000; border-color: var(--accent); }
        .btn.primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
        .btn.danger { background: var(--red); color: #fff; border-color: var(--red); }
        .btn.success { background: var(--green); color: #000; border-color: var(--green); }

        /* MAIN LAYOUT */
        .main {
            display: flex;
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* SIDEBAR */
        .sidebar {
            width: 220px;
            background: var(--bg2);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .sidebar-header {
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text2);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .conversations {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 8px;
        }

        .conv-item {
            padding: 8px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 13px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .conv-item:hover { background: var(--bg3); }
        .conv-item.active { background: var(--bg3); border-color: var(--accent); }

        .conv-title {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .conv-delete {
            color: var(--red);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            opacity: 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .conv-item:hover .conv-delete { opacity: 1; }

        /* CHAT AREA */
        .chat-area {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chat-toolbar {
            background: var(--bg2);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .context-info {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text2);
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .context-bar {
            width: 100px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--bg3);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: inline-block;
            vertical-align: middle;
            margin-left: 6px;
        }

        .context-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--green);
            transition: width 0.3s, background 0.3s;
        }

        .messages {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 16px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .message {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        .message.user { flex-direction: row-reverse; }

        .avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .message.user .avatar { background: var(--accent); color: #000; }
        .message.ai .avatar { background: var(--purple); color: #000; }
        .message.system .avatar { background: var(--yellow); color: #000; }

        .bubble {
            background: var(--bg2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            max-width: 80%;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .message.user .bubble {
            background: var(--bg3);
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .bubble pre {
            background: var(--bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 12px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            margin: 8px 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .bubble code {
            font-family: 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .copy-code-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 6px;
            right: 6px;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            font-size: 11px;
            background: var(--bg3);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .copy-code-btn:hover { background: var(--accent); color: #000; }

        /* CODE PANEL */
        .code-panel {
            width: 420px;
            background: var(--bg2);
            border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .code-panel-header {
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .code-panel-header h3 {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text2);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .code-tabs {
            display: flex;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--bg);
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .code-tab {
            padding: 7px 14px;
            font-size: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
            white-space: nowrap;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            color: var(--text2);
        }

        .code-tab:hover { background: var(--bg3); color: var(--text); }
        .code-tab.active { background: var(--bg2); color: var(--accent); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent); }

        .code-tab-close {
            opacity: 0;
            color: var(--red);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .code-tab:hover .code-tab-close { opacity: 1; }

        .code-editor-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .code-editor {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            border: none;
            padding: 12px;
            font-family: 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
            font-size: 13px;
            resize: none;
            outline: none;
            line-height: 1.6;
            tab-size: 2;
        }

        .code-actions {
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        /* INPUT AREA */
        .input-area {
            background: var(--bg2);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 12px;
        }

        .input-options {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .input-options label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text2);
        }

        .input-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            align-items: flex-end;
        }

        .input-box {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg3);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            resize: none;
            outline: none;
            min-height: 44px;
            max-height: 200px;
            font-family: inherit;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .input-box:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

        /* SETTINGS MODAL */
        .modal-overlay {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
            z-index: 1000;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }

        .modal {
            background: var(--bg2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 24px;
            width: 500px;
            max-width: 95vw;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .modal h2 {
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text2);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .form-group input, .form-group select, .form-group textarea {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 8px 12px;
        }

        .form-group textarea {
            background: var(--bg3);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 13px;
            outline: none;
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 80px;
            font-family: inherit;
        }

        .range-group {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .range-group input[type="range"] {
            flex: 1;
            accent-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .range-val {
            min-width: 50px;
            text-align: right;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .api-key-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .api-key-row input { flex: 1; }

        /* TOAST */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 20px;
            background: var(--bg3);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 10px 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(10px);
            transition: all 0.3s;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .toast.success { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); }
        .toast.error { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }

        /* SCROLLBAR */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 3px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--text2); }

        /* LOADING */
        .typing {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 4px 0;
        }

        .typing span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--text2);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: bounce 1.2s infinite;
        }

        .typing span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
        .typing span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

        @keyframes bounce {
            0%, 80%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.4; }
            40% { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 1; }
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 11px;
            background: var(--bg3);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text2);
        }

        .hidden { display: none !important; }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .sidebar { width: 180px; }
            .code-panel { width: 320px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HEADER -->
<div class="header">
    <h1>🤖 AI Code Studio</h1>
    <div class="header-controls">
        <select id="aiProvider" onchange="onProviderChange()">
            <option value="openai">OpenAI (GPT)</option>
            <option value="anthropic">Anthropic (Claude)</option>
            <option value="gemini">Google (Gemini)</option>
            <option value="groq">Groq (Llama/Mixtral)</option>
            <option value="openrouter">OpenRouter (Multi)</option>
            <option value="ollama">Ollama (Local)</option>
        </select>
        <select id="modelSelect" style="min-width:160px"></select>
        <button class="btn" onclick="openSettings()">⚙️ Config</button>
        <button class="btn primary" onclick="newConversation()">+ Nova Conversa</button>
        <button class="btn" onclick="toggleCodePanel()">📝 Código</button>
        <button class="btn" onclick="exportAll()">💾 Exportar</button>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- MAIN -->
<div class="main">

    <!-- SIDEBAR -->
    <div class="sidebar">
        <div class="sidebar-header">
            Conversas
            <button class="btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px" onclick="newConversation()">+</button>
        </div>
        <div class="conversations" id="convList"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- CHAT -->
    <div class="chat-area">
        <div class="chat-toolbar">
            <span id="convTitle" style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600">Nova Conversa</span>
            <div class="context-info">
                Contexto: <span id="tokenCount">0</span> tokens
                <div class="context-bar">
                    <div class="context-fill" id="contextFill" style="width:0%"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <button class="btn" onclick="clearContext()" title="Limpar contexto mantendo conversa">🗑️ Limpar Ctx</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="summarizeContext()" title="Resumir contexto para economizar tokens">📋 Resumir</button>
        </div>

        <div class="messages" id="messages"></div>

        <div class="input-area">
            <div class="input-options">
                <label>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="webSearchCheck"> 🌐 Web Search
                </label>
                <label>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="codeMode" checked> 💻 Modo Código
                </label>
                <label>
                    Temp:
                    <input type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="0.7" id="tempSlider" style="width:80px;accent-color:var(--accent);vertical-align:middle">
                    <span id="tempVal">0.7</span>
                </label>
                <label>
                    Max tokens:
                    <input type="number" id="maxTokens" value="4096" min="256" max="32000" style="width:80px">
                </label>
            </div>
            <div class="input-row">
                <textarea class="input-box" id="userInput" placeholder="Digite sua mensagem... (Ctrl+Enter para enviar)" rows="1"
                    onkeydown="handleKey(event)" oninput="autoResize(this)"></textarea>
                <button class="btn" onclick="pasteCode()" title="Colar código da área de transferência">📋 Colar</button>
                <button class="btn primary" onclick="sendMessage()" id="sendBtn">Enviar ▶</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CODE PANEL -->
    <div class="code-panel" id="codePanel">
        <div class="code-panel-header">
            <h3>📝 Editor de Código</h3>
            <button class="btn" onclick="newCodeTab()">+ Tab</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="importCodeFile()">📂 Importar</button>
        </div>
        <div class="code-tabs" id="codeTabs"></div>
        <div class="code-editor-wrap">
            <textarea class="code-editor" id="codeEditor" placeholder="// Cole ou escreva código aqui...
// O código será enviado junto com sua mensagem quando 'Modo Código' estiver ativo
// Use Ctrl+A para selecionar tudo" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="code-actions">
            <button class="btn success" onclick="copyCleanCode()">📋 Copiar Limpo</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="sendCodeToChat()">💬 Enviar p/ Chat</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="clearCode()">🗑️ Limpar</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="downloadCode()">⬇️ Baixar</button>
            <select id="codeLanguage" style="font-size:12px">
                <option value="javascript">JavaScript</option>
                <option value="python">Python</option>
                <option value="html">HTML</option>
                <option value="css">CSS</option>
                <option value="java">Java</option>
                <option value="csharp">C#</option>
                <option value="cpp">C++</option>
                <option value="php">PHP</option>
                <option value="sql">SQL</option>
                <option value="typescript">TypeScript</option>
                <option value="rust">Rust</option>
                <option value="go">Go</option>
                <option value="bash">Bash</option>
                <option value="text">Texto</option>
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- SETTINGS MODAL -->
<div class="modal-overlay" id="settingsModal">
    <div class="modal">
        <h2>⚙️ Configurações</h2>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>🔑 API Key (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Groq / OpenRouter)</label>
            <div class="api-key-row">
                <input type="password" id="apiKeyInput" placeholder="sk-... ou chave da API">
                <button class="btn" onclick="toggleApiVis()">👁️</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>🌐 Serper API Key (para Web Search)</label>
            <input type="password" id="serperKeyInput" placeholder="Chave da API Serper.dev">
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>🏠 Ollama URL (para modelos locais)</label>
            <input type="text" id="ollamaUrl" value="http://localhost:11434" placeholder="http://localhost:11434">
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>📏 Limite de Contexto (tokens estimados)</label>
            <div class="range-group">
                <input type="range" min="1000" max="200000" step="1000" value="8000" id="contextLimit"
                    oninput="document.getElementById('ctxVal').textContent=this.value">
                <span class="range-val" id="ctxVal">8000</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>✂️ Estratégia quando contexto encher</label>
            <select id="contextStrategy">
                <option value="trim">Remover mensagens antigas</option>
                <option value="summarize">Resumir automaticamente</option>
                <option value="warn">Apenas avisar</option>
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>🤖 System Prompt</label>
            <textarea id="systemPrompt" placeholder="Você é um assistente especialista em programação...">Você é um assistente especialista em programação. Quando gerar código:
1. Sempre use blocos de código com a linguagem especificada
2. Código deve ser limpo, sem caracteres estranhos
3. Comente o código em português
4. Se o código for grande, divida em partes lógicas
5. Explique o que cada parte faz</textarea>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label>🔄 Auto-save (segundos, 0 = desligado)</label>
            <input type="number" id="autoSaveInterval" value="30" min="0" max="300">
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:20px">
            <button class="btn" onclick="closeSettings()">Cancelar</button>
            <button class="btn primary" onclick="saveSettings()">💾 Salvar</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<!-- IMPORT FILE INPUT -->
<input type="file" id="fileImport" style="display:none" accept=".js,.py,.html,.css,.ts,.java,.cs,.cpp,.php,.sql,.txt,.json,.md" onchange="handleFileImport(event)">

<script>
// ==================== STATE ====================
let state = {
    conversations: {},
    activeConvId: null,
    codeTabs: [],
    activeCodeTab: 0,
    settings: {
        apiKey: '',
        serperKey: '',
        ollamaUrl: 'http://localhost:11434',
        contextLimit: 8000,
        contextStrategy: 'trim',
        systemPrompt: '',
        autoSaveInterval: 30,
        provider: 'openai',
        model: '',
        temperature: 0.7,
        maxTokens: 4096
    },
    isLoading: false,
    autoSaveTimer: null
};

// ==================== MODELS ====================
const MODELS = {
    openai: [
        'gpt-4o', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'gpt-4-turbo', 'gpt-4',
        'gpt-3.5-turbo', 'gpt-3.5-turbo-16k'
    ],
    anthropic: [
        'claude-opus-4-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5',
        'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022', 'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022',
        'claude-3-opus-20240229', 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229', 'claude-3-haiku-20240307'
    ],
    gemini: [
        'gemini-1.5-pro', 'gemini-1.5-flash', 'gemini-1.5-flash-8b',
        'gemini-pro', 'gemini-ultra'
    ],
    groq: [
        'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', 'llama-3.1-70b-versatile',
        'llama-3.1-8b-instant', 'mixtral-8x7b-32768',
        'gemma2-9b-it', 'gemma-7b-it'
    ],
    openrouter: [
        'openai/gpt-4o', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet',
        'google/gemini-pro-1.5', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct',
        'mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-instruct', 'deepseek/deepseek-coder',
        'qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct', 'microsoft/phi-3.5-mini-128k-instruct'
    ],
    ollama: ['llama3.2', 'codellama', 'mistral', 'phi3', 'qwen2.5-coder', 'deepseek-coder-v2']
};

// ==================== INIT ====================
function init() {
    loadFromStorage();
    updateModelSelect();
    renderConversations();
    setupAutoSave();

    if (!state.activeConvId || !state.conversations[state.activeConvId]) {
        newConversation();
    } else {
        loadConversation(state.activeConvId);
    }

    if (state.codeTabs.length === 0) {
        newCodeTab();
    } else {
        renderCodeTabs();
        loadCodeTab(state.activeCodeTab);
    }

    document.getElementById('tempSlider').addEventListener('input', function() {
        document.getElementById('tempVal').textContent = this.value;
    });

    showToast('✅ AI Code Studio carregado!', 'success');
}

// ==================== STORAGE ====================
function saveToStorage() {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem('aiStudio_state', JSON.stringify({
            conversations: state.conversations,
            activeConvId: state.activeConvId,
            codeTabs: state.codeTabs,
            activeCodeTab: state.activeCodeTab,
            settings: state.settings
        }));
    } catch(e) {
        showToast('⚠️ Erro ao salvar (storage cheio?)', 'error');
    }
}

function loadFromStorage() {
    try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('aiStudio_state');
        if (saved) {
            const data = JSON.parse(saved);
            state.conversations = data.conversations || {};
            state.activeConvId = data.activeConvId || null;
            state.codeTabs = data.codeTabs || [];
            state.activeCodeTab = data.activeCodeTab || 0;
            state.settings = { ...state.settings, ...(data.settings || {}) };

            // Restore UI settings
            document.getElementById('aiProvider').value = state.settings.provider || 'openai';
            document.getElementById('maxTokens').value = state.settings.maxTokens || 4096;
            document.getElementById('tempSlider').value = state.settings.temperature || 0.7;
            document.getElementById('tempVal').textContent = state.settings.temperature || 0.7;
        }
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('Erro ao carregar:', e);
    }
}

function setupAutoSave() {
    if (state.autoSaveTimer) clearInterval(state.autoSaveTimer);
    const interval = parseInt(state.settings.autoSaveInterval) || 30;
    if (interval > 0) {
        state.autoSaveTimer = setInterval(() => {
            saveToStorage();
            showToast('💾 Auto-saved', 'success');
        }, interval * 1000);
    }
}

// ==================== CONVERSATIONS ====================
function newConversation() {
    const id = 'conv_' + Date.now();
    state.conversations[id] = {
        id,
        title: 'Conversa ' + (Object.keys(state.conversations).length + 1),
        messages: [],
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        provider: document.getElementById('aiProvider').value,
        model: document.getElementById('modelSelect').value
    };
    state.activeConvId = id;
    saveToStorage();
    renderConversations();
    loadConversation(id);
}

function loadConversation(id) {
    state.activeConvId = id;
    const conv = state.conversations[id];
    if (!conv) return;

    document.getElementById('convTitle').textContent = conv.title;
    renderMessages(conv.messages);
    updateContextBar(conv.messages);
    renderConversations();
}

function deleteConversation(id, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!confirm('Deletar esta conversa?')) return;
    delete state.conversations[id];
    if (state.activeConvId === id) {
        const keys = Object.keys(state.conversations);
        if (keys.length > 0) loadConversation(keys[keys.length - 1]);
        else newConversation();
    }
    saveToStorage();
    renderConversations();
}

function renderConversations() {
    const list = document.getElementById('convList');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    const convs = Object.values(state.conversations).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);

    convs.forEach(conv => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'conv-item' + (conv.id === state.activeConvId ? ' active' : '');
        item.innerHTML = `
            <span class="conv-title" title="${conv.title}">${conv.title}</span>
            <span class="conv-delete" onclick="deleteConversation('${conv.id}', event)">✕</span>
        `;
        item.onclick = () => loadConversation(conv.id);
        list.appendChild(item);
    });
}

// ==================== MESSAGES ====================
function renderMessages(messages) {
    const container = document.getElementById('messages');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    messages.forEach(msg => appendMessageToDOM(msg));
    container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

function appendMessageToDOM(msg) {
    const container = document.getElementById('messages');
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = `message ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'user' : msg.role === 'system' ? 'system' : 'ai'}`;

    const avatarEmoji = msg.role === 'user' ? '👤' : msg.role === 'system' ? '⚙️' : '🤖';
    const content = formatMessage(msg.content);

    div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="avatar">${avatarEmoji}</div>
        <div class="bubble">${content}</div>
    `;

    container.appendChild(div);
    container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

function formatMessage(text) {
    // Detecta blocos de código
    text = text.replace(/```(\w+)?\n?([\s\S]*?)```/g, (match, lang, code) => {
        const cleanCode = cleanCodeOutput(code.trim());
        const language = lang || 'code';
        return `<pre><button class="copy-code-btn" onclick="copyCodeBlock(this)">📋 Copiar</button><code class="lang-${language}">${escapeHtml(cleanCode)}</code></pre>`;
    });

    // Negrito
    text = text.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
    // Itálico
    text = text.replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
    // Inline code
    text = text.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code style="background:var(--bg3);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px">$1</code>');
    // Quebras de linha
    text = text.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');

    return text;
}

function escapeHtml(text) {
    return text
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function cleanCodeOutput(code) {
    // Remove caracteres estranhos e bagunça comum em respostas de IA
    return code
        .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\r/g, '\n')
        .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '') // zero-width chars
        .replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ') // non-breaking space
        .replace(/[""]/g, '"') // smart quotes
        .replace(/['']/g, "'") // smart apostrophes
        .replace(/…/g, '...')
        .trim();
}

function copyCodeBlock(btn) {
    const code = btn.nextElementSibling.textContent;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanCodeOutput(code)).then(() => {
        btn.textContent = '✅ Copiado!';
        setTimeout(() => btn.textContent = '📋 Copiar', 2000);
    });
}

// ==================== SEND MESSAGE ====================
async function sendMessage() {
    if (state.isLoading) return;

    const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
    let text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    const codeMode = document.getElementById('codeMode').checked;
    const codeContent = document.getElementById('codeEditor').value.trim();

    if (codeMode && codeContent) {
        const lang = document.getElementById('codeLanguage').value;
        text += `\n\n**Código atual no editor:**\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${codeContent}\n\`\`\``;
    }

    const conv = state.conversations[state.activeConvId];
    if (!conv) return;

    // Add user message
    const userMsg = { role: 'user', content: text, timestamp: Date.now() };
    conv.messages.push(userMsg);
    appendMessageToDOM(userMsg);

    // Update title if first message
    if (conv.messages.length === 1) {
        conv.title = text.substring(0, 40) + (text.length > 40 ? '...' : '');
        document.getElementById('convTitle').textContent = conv.title;
        renderConversations();
    }

    input.value = '';
    autoResize(input);
    updateContextBar(conv.messages);

    // Show loading
    state.isLoading = true;
    document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
    const loadingDiv = addLoadingMessage();

    try {
        // Web search if enabled
        let webContext = '';
        if (document.getElementById('webSearchCheck').checked) {
            webContext = await doWebSearch(text);
        }

        const response = await callAI(conv.messages, webContext);

        loadingDiv.remove();

        const aiMsg = { role: 'assistant', content: response, timestamp: Date.now() };
        conv.messages.push(aiMsg);
        appendMessageToDOM(aiMsg);

        // Auto-extract code to editor
        const codeMatch = response.match(/```(\w+)?\n?([\s\S]*?)```/);
        if (codeMatch && codeMode) {
            const extractedCode = cleanCodeOutput(codeMatch[2]);
            const activeTab = state.codeTabs[state.activeCodeTab];
            if (activeTab) {
                activeTab.content = extractedCode;
                activeTab.language = codeMatch[1] || 'text';
                document.getElementById('codeEditor').value = extractedCode;
                document.getElementById('codeLanguage').value = codeMatch[1] || 'text';
                showToast('💻 Código extraído para o editor!', 'success');
            }
        }

        updateContextBar(conv.messages);
        checkContextLimit(conv);
        saveToStorage();

    } catch (err) {
        loadingDiv.remove();
        const errMsg = { role: 'system', content: `❌ Erro: ${err.message}`, timestamp: Date.now() };
        conv.messages.push(errMsg);
        appendMessageToDOM(errMsg);
        showToast('❌ ' + err.message, 'error');
    }

    state.isLoading = false;
    document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
}

function addLoadingMessage() {
    const container = document.getElementById('messages');
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'message ai';
    div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="avatar">🤖</div>
        <div class="bubble">
            <div class="typing">
                <span></span><span></span><span></span>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(div);
    container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
    return div;
}

// ==================== AI CALLS ====================
async function callAI(messages, webContext = '') {
    const provider = document.getElementById('aiProvider').value;
    const model = document.getElementById('modelSelect').value;
    const apiKey = state.settings.apiKey;
    const temp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tempSlider').value);
    const maxTok = parseInt(document.getElementById('maxTokens').value);
    const contextLimit = parseInt(state.settings.contextLimit) || 8000;

    // Build messages with context limit
    let msgs = buildContextMessages(messages, contextLimit, webContext);

    switch(provider) {
        case 'openai': return await callOpenAI(msgs, model, apiKey, temp, maxTok);
        case 'anthropic': return await callAnthropic(msgs, model, apiKey, temp, maxTok);
        case 'gemini': return await callGemini(msgs, model, apiKey, temp, maxTok);
        case 'groq': return await callGroq(msgs, model, apiKey, temp, maxTok);
        case 'openrouter': return await callOpenRouter(msgs, model, apiKey, temp, maxTok);
        case 'ollama': return await callOllama(msgs, model, temp, maxTok);
        default: throw new Error('Provider não suportado');
    }
}

function buildContextMessages(messages, limit, webContext) {
    const systemPrompt = state.settings.systemPrompt ||
        'Você é um assistente especialista em programação. Gere código limpo, sem caracteres estranhos, comentado em português.';

    let sysContent = systemPrompt;
    if (webContext) sysContent += `\n\nResultados da web:\n${webContext}`;

    const sys = [{ role: 'system', content: sysContent }];

    // Estimate tokens (rough: 1 token ≈ 4 chars)
    let tokenCount = sysContent.length / 4;
    const filtered = [];

    // Add from newest to oldest until limit
    for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msg = messages[i];
        if (msg.role === 'system') continue;
        const msgTokens = msg.content.length / 4;
        if (tokenCount + msgTokens > limit && filtered.length > 0) break;
        tokenCount += msgTokens;
        filtered.unshift({ role: msg.role === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' : 'user', content: msg.content });
    }

    return [...sys, ...filtered];
}

async function callOpenAI(messages, model, apiKey, temp, maxTokens) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('API Key OpenAI não configurada! Vá em ⚙️ Config');

    const res = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages, temperature: temp, max_tokens: maxTokens })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error?.message || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    return data.choices[0].message.content;
}

async function callAnthropic(messages, model, apiKey, temp, maxTokens) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('API Key Anthropic não configurada! Vá em ⚙️ Config');

    const system = messages.find(m => m.role === 'system')?.content || '';
    const msgs = messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'system');

    const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'x-api-key': apiKey,
            'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            model, messages: msgs, system,
            temperature: temp, max_tokens: maxTokens
        })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error?.message || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    return data.content[0].text;
}

async function callGemini(messages, model, apiKey, temp, maxTokens) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('API Key Gemini não configurada! Vá em ⚙️ Config');

    const contents = messages
        .filter(m => m.role !== 'system')
        .map(m => ({
            role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',
            parts: [{ text: m.content }]
        }));

    const res = await fetch(
        `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`,
        {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                contents,
                generationConfig: { temperature: temp, maxOutputTokens: maxTokens }
            })
        }
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error?.message || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    return data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
}

async function callGroq(messages, model, apiKey, temp, maxTokens) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('API Key Groq não configurada! Vá em ⚙️ Config');

    const res = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages, temperature: temp, max_tokens: maxTokens })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error?.message || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    return data.choices[0].message.content;
}

async function callOpenRouter(messages, model, apiKey, temp, maxTokens) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('API Key OpenRouter não configurada! Vá em ⚙️ Config');

    const res = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
            'HTTP-Referer': window.location.href,
            'X-Title': 'AI Code Studio'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages, temperature: temp, max_tokens: maxTokens })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error?.message || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    return data.choices[0].message.content;
}

async function callOllama(messages, model, temp, maxTokens) {
    const url = state.settings.ollamaUrl || 'http://localhost:11434';

    const res = await fetch(`${url}/api/chat`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            model,
            messages: messages.map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
            options: { temperature: temp, num_predict: maxTokens },
            stream: false
        })
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Ollama HTTP ${res.status} - Servidor rodando?`);

    const data = await res.json();
    return data.message.content;
}

// ==================== WEB SEARCH ====================
async function doWebSearch(query) {
    const key = state.settings.serperKey;
    if (!key) {
        showToast('⚠️ Configure a Serper API Key para web search', 'error');
        return '';
    }

    try {
        const res = await fetch('https://google.serper.dev/search', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-API-KEY': key
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ q: query, num: 5 })
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        const results = data.organic?.slice(0, 5).map(r =>
            `**${r.title}**\n${r.snippet}\nURL: ${r.link}`
        ).join('\n\n') || '';

        return results ? `Resultados de busca para "${query}":\n\n${results}` : '';
    } catch(e) {
        showToast('⚠️ Erro na busca web', 'error');
        return '';
    }
}

// ==================== CONTEXT MANAGEMENT ====================
function estimateTokens(messages) {
    return Math.ceil(messages.reduce((acc, m) => acc + (m.content?.length || 0), 0) / 4);
}

function updateContextBar(messages) {
    const tokens = estimateTokens(messages);
    const limit = parseInt(state.settings.contextLimit) || 8000;
    const pct = Math.min(100, (tokens / limit) * 100);

    document.getElementById('tokenCount').textContent = tokens.toLocaleString();

    const fill = document.getElementById('contextFill');
    fill.style.width = pct + '%';
    fill.style.background = pct > 80 ? 'var(--red)' : pct > 60 ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--green)';
}

function checkContextLimit(conv) {
    const tokens = estimateTokens(conv.messages);
    const limit = parseInt(state.settings.contextLimit) || 8000;

    if (tokens > limit) {
        const strategy = state.settings.contextStrategy;
        if (strategy === 'trim') {
            // Remove oldest messages (keep system + last 10)
            while (estimateTokens(conv.messages) > limit && conv.messages.length > 4) {
                conv.messages.splice(0, 1);
            }
            showToast('✂️ Contexto trimado automaticamente', 'success');
        } else if (strategy === 'warn') {
            showToast('⚠️ Limite de contexto atingido!', 'error');
        }
    }
}

function clearContext() {
    const conv = state.conversations[state.activeConvId];
    if (!conv) return;
    if (!confirm('Limpar contexto? As mensagens serão mantidas mas a IA não vai "lembrar" delas.')) return;
    conv.messages = [];
    renderMessages([]);
    updateContextBar([]);
    saveToStorage();
    showToast('🗑️ Contexto limpo!', 'success');
}

async function summarizeContext() {
    const conv = state.conversations[state.activeConvId];
    if (!conv || conv.messages.length < 4) {
        showToast('Poucas mensagens para resumir', 'error');
        return;
    }

    showToast('📋 Resumindo contexto...', 'success');

    const summaryPrompt = `Faça um resumo conciso desta conversa em bullet points, mantendo os pontos técnicos importantes:\n\n${
        conv.messages.map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.content.substring(0, 500)}`).join('\n')
    }`;

    try {
        const tempMsgs = [
            { role: 'system', content: 'Você é um assistente que resume conversas de forma concisa.' },
            { role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }
        ];

        const summary = await callAI(tempMsgs);
        conv.messages = [{ role: 'system', content: `📋 Resumo da conversa anterior:\n${summary}`, timestamp: Date.now() }];
        renderMessages(conv.messages);
        updateContextBar(conv.messages);
        saveToStorage();
        showToast('✅ Contexto resumido!', 'success');
    } catch(e) {
        showToast('❌ Erro ao resumir: ' + e.message, 'error');
    }
}

// ==================== CODE TABS ====================
function newCodeTab(name = null) {
    const tab = {
        id: Date.now(),
        name: name || `código_${state.codeTabs.length + 1}`,
        content: '',
        language: 'javascript'
    };
    state.codeTabs.push(tab);
    state.activeCodeTab = state.codeTabs.length - 1;
    renderCodeTabs();
    loadCodeTab(state.activeCodeTab);
    saveToStorage();
}

function renderCodeTabs() {
    const container = document.getElementById('codeTabs');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    state.codeTabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'code-tab' + (i === state.activeCodeTab ? ' active' : '');
        div.innerHTML = `
            <span onclick="switchCodeTab(${i})">${tab.name}</span>
            <span class="code-tab-close" onclick="closeCodeTab(${i}, event)">✕</span>
        `;
        container.appendChild(div);
    });
}

function switchCodeTab(i) {
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
    state.activeCodeTab = i;
    loadCodeTab(i);
    renderCodeTabs();
}

function closeCodeTab(i, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (state.codeTabs.length === 1) { showToast('Mínimo 1 tab', 'error'); return; }
    state.codeTabs.splice(i, 1);
    if (state.activeCodeTab >= state.codeTabs.length) state.activeCodeTab = state.codeTabs.length - 1;
    renderCodeTabs();
    loadCodeTab(state.activeCodeTab);
    saveToStorage();
}

function loadCodeTab(i) {
    const tab = state.codeTabs[i];
    if (!tab) return;
    document.getElementById('codeEditor').value = tab.content;
    document.getElementById('codeLanguage').value = tab.language || 'javascript';
}

function saveCurrentCodeTab() {
    const tab = state.codeTabs[state.activeCodeTab];
    if (!tab) return;
    tab.content = document.getElementById('codeEditor').value;
    tab.language = document.getElementById('codeLanguage').value;
}

function copyCleanCode() {
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
    const code = document.getElementById('codeEditor').value;
    const clean = cleanCodeOutput(code);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(clean).then(() => {
        showToast('✅ Código limpo copiado!', 'success');
    });
}

function sendCodeToChat() {
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
    const code = document.getElementById('codeEditor').value.trim();
    const lang = document.getElementById('codeLanguage').value;
    if (!code) { showToast('Editor vazio!', 'error'); return; }

    const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
    input.value = `Analise e melhore este código:\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${code}\n\`\`\``;
    autoResize(input);
    input.focus();
}

function clearCode() {
    if (!confirm('Limpar editor?')) return;
    document.getElementById('codeEditor').value = '';
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
}

function downloadCode() {
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
    const tab = state.codeTabs[state.activeCodeTab];
    const code = cleanCodeOutput(tab.content);
    const ext = { javascript:'js', python:'py', html:'html', css:'css', java:'java',
                   csharp:'cs', cpp:'cpp', php:'php', sql:'sql', typescript:'ts',
                   rust:'rs', go:'go', bash:'sh', text:'txt' }[tab.language] || 'txt';

    const blob = new Blob([code], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `${tab.name}.${ext}`;
    a.click();
    showToast('⬇️ Download iniciado!', 'success');
}

function importCodeFile() {
    document.getElementById('fileImport').click();
}

function handleFileImport(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
        const content = ev.target.result;
        const ext = file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
        const langMap = { js:'javascript', py:'python', html:'html', css:'css',
                          java:'java', cs:'csharp', cpp:'cpp', php:'php',
                          sql:'sql', ts:'typescript', rs:'rust', go:'go', sh:'bash' };

        newCodeTab(file.name);
        const tab = state.codeTabs[state.activeCodeTab];
        tab.content = content;
        tab.language = langMap[ext] || 'text';
        document.getElementById('codeEditor').value = content;
        document.getElementById('codeLanguage').value = tab.language;
        renderCodeTabs();
        saveToStorage();
        showToast(`📂 ${file.name} importado!`, 'success');
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
    e.target.value = '';
}

// ==================== SETTINGS ====================
function openSettings() {
    document.getElementById('apiKeyInput').value = state.settings.apiKey || '';
    document.getElementById('serperKeyInput').value = state.settings.serperKey || '';
    document.getElementById('ollamaUrl').value = state.settings.ollamaUrl || 'http://localhost:11434';
    document.getElementById('contextLimit').value = state.settings.contextLimit || 8000;
    document.getElementById('ctxVal').textContent = state.settings.contextLimit || 8000;
    document.getElementById('contextStrategy').value = state.settings.contextStrategy || 'trim';
    document.getElementById('systemPrompt').value = state.settings.systemPrompt || '';
    document.getElementById('autoSaveInterval').value = state.settings.autoSaveInterval || 30;
    document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.add('open');
}

function closeSettings() {
    document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.remove('open');
}

function saveSettings() {
    state.settings.apiKey = document.getElementById('apiKeyInput').value;
    state.settings.serperKey = document.getElementById('serperKeyInput').value;
    state.settings.ollamaUrl = document.getElementById('ollamaUrl').value;
    state.settings.contextLimit = parseInt(document.getElementById('contextLimit').value);
    state.settings.contextStrategy = document.getElementById('contextStrategy').value;
    state.settings.systemPrompt = document.getElementById('systemPrompt').value;
    state.settings.autoSaveInterval = parseInt(document.getElementById('autoSaveInterval').value);
    state.settings.provider = document.getElementById('aiProvider').value;
    state.settings.model = document.getElementById('modelSelect').value;
    state.settings.temperature = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tempSlider').value);
    state.settings.maxTokens = parseInt(document.getElementById('maxTokens').value);

    saveToStorage();
    setupAutoSave();
    closeSettings();
    showToast('✅ Configurações salvas!', 'success');
}

function toggleApiVis() {
    const input = document.getElementById('apiKeyInput');
    input.type = input.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
}

// ==================== PROVIDER / MODEL ====================
function onProviderChange() {
    updateModelSelect();
}

function updateModelSelect() {
    const provider = document.getElementById('aiProvider').value;
    const select = document.getElementById('modelSelect');
    const models = MODELS[provider] || [];
    select.innerHTML = models.map(m => `<option value="${m}">${m}</option>`).join('');

    // Restore saved model if same provider
    if (state.settings.provider === provider && state.settings.model) {
        const exists = models.includes(state.settings.model);
        if (exists) select.value = state.settings.model;
    }
}

// ==================== PASTE CODE ====================
async function pasteCode() {
    try {
        const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
        if (!text) { showToast('Área de transferência vazia', 'error'); return; }

        // Detecta se parece código
        const looksLikeCode = /[{}();=><\/\\]/.test(text) || text.includes('def ') || text.includes('function ');

        if (looksLikeCode) {
            // Pergunta se vai pro editor ou pro chat
            const toEditor = confirm('Parece código!\n\nOK = Colar no Editor de Código\nCancelar = Colar no Chat');
            if (toEditor) {
                document.getElementById('codeEditor').value = text;
                saveCurrentCodeTab();
                showToast('✅ Código colado no editor!', 'success');
                return;
            }
        }

        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        input.value += text;
        autoResize(input);
        showToast('✅ Colado no chat!', 'success');
    } catch(e) {
        showToast('❌ Sem permissão para acessar clipboard', 'error');
    }
}

// ==================== EXPORT ====================
function exportAll() {
    const data = {
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        conversations: state.conversations,
        codeTabs: state.codeTabs,
        settings: { ...state.settings, apiKey: '***', serperKey: '***' }
    };

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `ai-studio-backup-${Date.now()}.json`;
    a.click();
    showToast('💾 Backup exportado!', 'success');
}

// ==================== UI HELPERS ====================
function toggleCodePanel() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('codePanel');
    panel.classList.toggle('hidden');
}

function handleKey(e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        sendMessage();
    }
    // Tab no textarea = inserir espaços
    if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const ta = e.target;
        const start = ta.selectionStart;
        const end = ta.selectionEnd;
        ta.value = ta.value.substring(0, start) + '  ' + ta.value.substring(end);
        ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = start + 2;
    }
}

function autoResize(el) {
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = Math.min(el.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
}

function showToast(msg, type = '') {
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.className = 'toast show ' + type;
    clearTimeout(toast._timer);
    toast._timer = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.className = 'toast';
    }, 3000);
}

// Fecha modal clicando fora
document.getElementById('settingsModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) closeSettings();
});

// Salva código ao digitar
document.getElementById('codeEditor').addEventListener('input', () => {
    saveCurrentCodeTab();
});

// Salva provider/model ao mudar
document.getElementById('modelSelect').addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.settings.model = document.getElementById('modelSelect').value;
    saveToStorage();
});

// ==================== START ====================
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>


<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0d1117"/>
<title>Iara Suite — Editor</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0d1117;--bg2:#161b22;--bg3:#21262d;--bg4:#30363d;
  --border:#30363d;--border2:#21262d;
  --text:#e6edf3;--muted:#8b949e;--muted2:#6e7681;
  --primary:#58a6ff;--primary-bg:rgba(88,166,255,.12);--primary-dark:rgba(88,166,255,.06);
  --green:#3fb950;--green-bg:rgba(63,185,80,.12);
  --yellow:#d29922;--yellow-bg:rgba(210,153,34,.12);
  --red:#f85149;--red-bg:rgba(248,81,73,.12);
  --purple:#bc8cff;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
button{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--primary)}
textarea{resize:none}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg2)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bg4);border-radius:3px}
#nav{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:0 10px;height:48px;flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto}
#nav::-webkit-scrollbar{height:0}
.nav-logo{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--text);margin-right:10px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-logo span{color:var(--primary)}
.tab-btn{background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.tab-btn:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
.tab-btn.active{background:var(--primary-bg);color:var(--primary)}
.nav-sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border);margin:0 4px;flex-shrink:0}
#panels{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.panel{display:none;flex:1;overflow:hidden}
.panel.active{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px}
.btn{border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:.15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-primary{background:var(--primary);color:#000}.btn-primary:hover{background:#79c0ff}
.btn-secondary{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border)}.btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}
.btn-ghost{background:none;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--border)}.btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--muted)}
.btn-success{background:var(--green);color:#000}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;gap:3px}
.badge-blue{background:rgba(88,166,255,.15);color:var(--primary)}
.badge-green{background:rgba(63,185,80,.15);color:var(--green)}
.badge-yellow{background:rgba(210,153,34,.15);color:var(--yellow)}
.badge-red{background:rgba(248,81,73,.15);color:var(--red)}
.badge-purple{background:rgba(188,140,255,.15);color:var(--purple)}
.badge-muted{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--muted)}
.alert{padding:9px 13px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.alert-info{background:var(--primary-bg);border:1px solid rgba(88,166,255,.3);color:#79c0ff}
.alert-warn{background:var(--yellow-bg);border:1px solid rgba(210,153,34,.3);color:var(--yellow)}
.alert-success{background:var(--green-bg);border:1px solid rgba(63,185,80,.3);color:var(--green)}
.alert-err{background:var(--red-bg);border:1px solid rgba(248,81,73,.3);color:var(--red)}
.flex{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.flex-between{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:3px}
.inp-grp{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.inp-grp input,.inp-grp select,.inp-grp textarea{width:100%}
.spinner{width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-top-color:var(--primary);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .6s linear infinite;flex-shrink:0}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.sec-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:8px}
.mono{font-family:'Cascadia Code','Fira Code','Courier New',monospace;font-size:12px}
.prog-wrap{height:5px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0}
.prog-bar{height:100%;background:var(--primary);border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s}
/* EDITOR */
#editor-panel{flex-direction:row;height:100%}
#ed-sidebar{width:210px;min-width:160px;background:var(--bg2);border-right:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}
#ed-sidebar-top{padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:6px}
#ed-sidebar-top input{flex:1;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px}
#file-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px}
.file-item{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-family:'Cascadia Code','Courier New',monospace;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;transition:.1s;user-select:none}
.file-item:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
.file-item.active{background:var(--primary-bg);color:var(--primary)}
.file-item .fia{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:2px;opacity:0}
.file-item:hover .fia{opacity:1}
.fib{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0 3px;font-size:11px;line-height:1;color:var(--muted)}
.fib:hover{color:var(--red)}
#ed-sidebar-foot{padding:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#ed-main{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
#ed-toolbar{padding:6px 10px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0}
#ed-fname{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:'Courier New',monospace;background:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;min-width:80px;max-width:220px;transition:.15s}
#ed-fname:hover{border-color:var(--border);background:var(--bg3)}
#ed-fname:focus{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);outline:none}
.lbadge{font-size:10px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg3);color:var(--muted);font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.pmb{background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.pmb:hover{border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}
.pmb.active{background:var(--primary-bg);border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}
#ed-work{flex:1;display:flex;overflow:hidden}
#code-wrap{display:flex;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);flex:1;transition:flex .25s}
#line-nums{width:46px;min-width:46px;background:var(--bg2);border-right:1px solid var(--border2);padding:14px 0;overflow:hidden;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;font-family:'Cascadia Code','Fira Code','Courier New',monospace;color:var(--muted2);text-align:right;user-select:none;flex-shrink:0}
.ln{display:block;padding-right:8px;height:21.45px}
#code-ta{flex:1;background:transparent;color:var(--text);border:none;padding:14px 16px;font-size:13px;font-family:'Cascadia Code','Fira Code','Courier New',monospace;line-height:1.65;outline:none;tab-size:2;overflow:auto;white-space:pre;word-wrap:normal}
#ed-divider{width:5px;background:var(--border);cursor:col-resize;flex-shrink:0;display:none;transition:background .15s}
#ed-divider:hover,#ed-divider.drag{background:var(--primary)}
#ed-divider.show{display:block}
#preview-wrap{display:none;flex-direction:column;border-left:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
#preview-wrap.split{display:flex;flex:1}
#preview-wrap.full{display:flex;flex:9999}
#preview-bar{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:4px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}
#preview-bar span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);flex:1}
#preview-frame{flex:1;border:none;background:#fff;width:100%;height:100%}
#ai-panel{width:310px;min-width:250px;background:var(--bg2);border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex-shrink:0}
#ai-panel.hidden{display:none}
#ai-head{padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0}
#ai-head-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
#ai-prov{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
#ai-msgs{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.ai-msg{padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word}
.ai-msg.user{background:var(--primary-bg);border:1px solid rgba(88,166,255,.2)}
.ai-msg.assistant{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.ai-msg.sys{background:var(--yellow-bg);border:1px solid rgba(210,153,34,.2);color:var(--yellow);font-size:11px}
#ai-foot{padding:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}
#ai-ta{width:100%;min-height:60px;max-height:130px;font-size:12px;padding:7px}
#ai-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}
#ai-st{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#keys-modal{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);z-index:900;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#keys-modal.open{display:flex}
#keys-box{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:20px;width:min(560px,95vw);max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto}
.slot-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.slot-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.slot-badge{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg4);color:var(--muted)}
.slot-badge.on{background:var(--green);color:#000}
.act-btn{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.act-btn:hover{border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}
.act-btn.on{background:var(--green);color:#000;border-color:var(--green)}
.code-modal{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.8);z-index:800;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.code-modal.open{display:flex}
.code-box{background:#0d1117;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;width:min(820px,96vw);max-height:88vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.code-box-head{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.code-box-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:14px}
.code-box-body pre{font-size:11px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;color:#79c0ff;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;line-height:1.5}
/* MAPPER */
#mapper-panel{overflow-y:auto}
#mapper-inner{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.drop-zone{border:2px dashed var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:32px 16px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;color:var(--muted)}
.drop-zone:hover,.drop-zone.over{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-dark);color:var(--primary)}
.ext-tabs{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ext-tab{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.ext-tab.active{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
.ext-content{display:none}
.ext-content.active{display:block}
.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(100px,1fr));gap:8px}
.stat-tile{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.stat-num{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.stat-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.rel-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.dep-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border2);font-size:11px}
.dep-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.api-row{padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border2);font-size:11px}
.api-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.api-method{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-right:6px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.m-get{background:rgba(63,185,80,.2);color:var(--green)}
.m-post{background:rgba(88,166,255,.2);color:var(--primary)}
.m-put{background:rgba(210,153,34,.2);color:var(--yellow)}
.m-delete{background:rgba(248,81,73,.2);color:var(--red)}
.m-any{background:var(--bg4);color:var(--muted)}
.tree-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:.1s;font-size:12px;font-family:'Cascadia Code','Courier New',monospace;line-height:1.8}
.tree-line:hover{background:var(--bg3)}
.tree-line.tfile:hover{background:var(--primary-bg)}
.tl-send{margin-left:auto;opacity:0;font-size:10px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--primary);color:var(--primary);background:none;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.tree-line:hover .tl-send{opacity:1}
.type-bar{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.type-pill{font-size:10px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:680px){
  #ed-sidebar{width:100%;height:100px;border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);min-width:unset}
  #editor-panel{flex-direction:column}
  #ai-panel{width:100%;border-left:none;border-top:1px solid var(--border);max-height:250px}
  .g2,.g3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<nav id="nav">
  <div class="nav-logo">⚡ <span>Iara</span> Suite</div>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="editor">💻 Editor</button>
  <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="mapper">🗺️ Mapa</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="openKeysModal()">🔑 Chaves API</button>
</nav>
<div id="panels">

<!-- EDITOR -->
<div class="panel active" id="editor-panel">
  <div id="ed-sidebar">
    <div id="ed-sidebar-top">
      <input id="nfi" type="text" placeholder="novo arquivo…" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')newFile()">
      <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px" onclick="newFile()">+</button>
    </div>
    <div id="file-list"></div>
    <div id="ed-sidebar-foot">
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="flex:1;font-size:10px;padding:4px" onclick="qs('#zip-import').click()">📥 ZIP</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="flex:1;font-size:10px;padding:4px" onclick="exportZip()">📤 ZIP</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="ed-main">
    <div id="ed-toolbar">
      <input id="ed-fname" type="text" value="sem arquivo" title="Clique para renomear"
        onblur="renameFile()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){renameFile();this.blur()}if(event.key==='Escape')this.blur()">
      <span id="lbadge" class="lbadge"></span>
      <div style="flex:1"></div>
      <button class="pmb active" id="pm-off"   onclick="setPM('off')"   title="Só código">📝</button>
      <button class="pmb"        id="pm-split" onclick="setPM('split')" title="Split">⚡</button>
      <button class="pmb"        id="pm-full"  onclick="setPM('full')"  title="Full preview">🔲</button>
      <div class="nav-sep"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px" onclick="saveFile()" title="Ctrl+S">💾</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px" onclick="toggleAI()">🤖 IA</button>
    </div>
    <div id="ed-work">
      <div id="code-wrap">
        <div id="line-nums"></div>
        <textarea id="code-ta" spellcheck="false"
          placeholder="Selecione ou crie um arquivo…"
          oninput="onCodeInput()"
          onkeydown="codeKD(event)"
          onscroll="syncScroll()"></textarea>
      </div>
      <div id="ed-divider" onmousedown="startDrag(event)"></div>
      <div id="preview-wrap">
        <div id="preview-bar">
          <span id="prev-lbl">🟢 Preview ao vivo</span>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:2px 7px;font-size:10px" onclick="refreshPreview()">🔄</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:2px 7px;font-size:10px" onclick="openPrevTab()">↗</button>
        </div>
        <iframe id="preview-frame"
          sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-pointer-lock"></iframe>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="ai-panel" class="hidden">
    <div id="ai-head">
      <div id="ai-head-top">
        <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600">🤖 Jasmim — IA</span>
        <div class="flex" style="gap:3px">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px" onclick="clearAI()">🗑</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px" onclick="insertCode()" title="Inserir último código">⬅</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:3px 6px;font-size:12px" onclick="toggleAI()">✕</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="ai-prov">Nenhuma chave configurada</div>
    </div>
    <div id="ai-msgs"></div>
    <div id="ai-foot">
      <textarea id="ai-ta" placeholder="Peça código, tire dúvidas… (Ctrl+Enter envia)" onkeydown="aiKD(event)"></textarea>
      <div id="ai-btns">
        <span id="ai-st">aguardando</span>
        <button class="btn btn-secondary" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px" onclick="sendWithCode()">📋+código</button>
